errors.text_span: В участъка между 2013 г. и 2015 г. линията е хоризонтална, показвайки липса на промяна при стойност 13
errors.evidence: The description claims the line is horizontal between 2013 and 2015, indicating no change. However, the data point for 2013 is at approximately 12.5, while the points for 2014 and 2015 are at approximately 13, showing an increase followed by a plateau, not a completely horizontal line for the entire period.
The description states that the second (dotted) line starts from the year 2010. The chart shows this line starting after 2010, at approximately 2011, aligned with the start of the first line.
